Store news: new counters open

Three new service counters opened this month across our larger stores, and they handle returns, exchanges and warranty claims in one queue instead of sending customers between two desks as before. The latest counters are staffed from opening until an hour before closing.

Staff on the new counters can process a warranty claim end to end, including printing the replacement authorisation, which previously required a supervisor to sign off in a back office. Early figures suggest the average wait has fallen by about a third since the change, though the sample is small and covers only the first few weeks of operation.

We plan to extend the same layout to the remaining stores through the current quarter, starting with the branches that report the longest queues on weekend afternoons.
